notes: S2/F38/F61-1 control (§9.4 case 1): a device declaration recorded at T0 is self-signed by a key with a valid key-compromise revocation effective at T1. §9.4 judges every signature by the key, the declaration's own self-signature included; the container's verified, trusted receipt (genTime T0, no accuracy) is strictly before T1, so the self-signature is rescued and the declaration is valid.
